title: Simplify
info: These use the identities 1 + tan²A = sec²A, 1 − sin²A = cos²A, and sin²A + cos²A = 1.
Square roots are taken as positive, the way they are in the worked examples.

questions.explain: 1 − sin²θ = cos²θ, so the positive square root is cos θ. tan θ × cos θ = (sin θ/cos θ) × cos θ = sin θ.
1 + tan²A = sec²A, so the positive square root is sec A. 1/sec A = cos A.
1 − sin²A = cos²A, so the positive square root is cos A. sec A / cos A = 1/cos²A = sec²A.
